meta.attribution: Player and club data: FC 26 player database (EA Sports FC 26 ratings). Real squads across 27 leagues — the English pyramid (Premier League, Championship, League One, League Two), La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, Eredivisie, Primeira Liga, Pro League, MLS, Superliga, Liga Profesional, Süper Lig, Saudi Pro League, Chinese Super League, K League 1, Ekstraklasa, Superliga (Romania), Eliteserien, Allsvenskan, Swiss Super League, Austrian Bundesliga, Scottish Premiership, A-League Men, Indian Super League and the League of Ireland Premier Division. League ratings are derived from squad ratings, not an external feed.
